 Established in February 2017, KD Pressing is an industrial manufacturer of a wide range of sheet metal components and sub assemblies for India's automotive industry, with a 5,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility.

 Respect for law, ethics and people keeps every activity of the business transparent. That makes us the preferred choice of our business partners.

 What we do
 Our Capabilities

 From a coil or sheet to a finished, inspected part, handled under one roof.

 Press work
 Mechanical power presses from 10 ton to 150 ton for sheet metal components.

 Shearing & blanking
 Sheet cutting on a 1525 mm × 4 mm shearing machine, plus decoiler-fed stock.

 Sub assemblies
 Drilling, orbital riveting and surface grinding, with welding equipment proposed.

 Inspection & testing

 Quick answers
 Frequently Asked Questions

 Short answers about KD Pressing, our plant and how to order.

 What does KD Pressing manufacture?
 KD Pressing manufactures sheet metal components and sub assemblies for India's automotive industry, including brackets, plates, washers and bent parts, made to the customer's drawing.
 Where is KD Pressing located?
 KD Pressing is in Waluj MIDC, Aurangabad, Maharashtra, India, at Plot No 09, GUT No. 23, Sai Udyog Nagari, Behind Cosmo Films, Kamlapur Village, 431 136. The manufacturing facility covers 5,000 sq ft.
 When was KD Pressing established?
 KD Pressing was established in February 2017. Its tagline is Quality. Assured.
 What press capacity does KD Pressing have?
 KD Pressing runs 22 mechanical power presses in eight sizes, from 10 ton to 150 ton, supported by a 1525 mm by 4 mm shearing machine and a manual decoiler for coil feed, plus an inverter-base CO2 welding machine.
 Which industries and customers does KD Pressing serve?
 KD Pressing serves the automotive industry as a third party vendor for Tier-II vendors of the BAL cluster. Customers include Sakshi Industries, Shree Saigan Industries, Om Auto Comp's and Baba Engineers.
 How does KD Pressing check quality?
 Parts are tested and measured with a UTM, a hardness tester, a CMM and calibrated Baker micrometer, vernier calliper and height gauge, all under the 5S workplace system.
 What secondary operations does KD Pressing offer?
 Alongside pressing and shearing, KD Pressing offers drilling, orbital riveting and surface grinding for sub assemblies. Inverter-base CO2 welding is done in-house, and projection and spot welding machines are planned.
 How do I request a quote from KD Pressing?
 Email corporate@kdpressing.com or call +91 99708 43177 or +91 99222 22088 with the part name or drawing, the material and thickness, and the monthly quantity.

 Have a part in mind?
 Send us the drawing, material, thickness and monthly quantity.

## About KD Pressing | Sheet Metal Pressing Company Since 2017
URL: https://www.kdpressing.com/about.html

Home / Company / About Us About KD Pressing
 A sheet metal pressing company serving India's automotive industry since 2017.

 Our story

 Pressing with Precision, Building with Purpose

 Continuous innovation Safe working environment Empowered employees Law, ethics & people 

 Established in February 2017, KD Pressing is an industrial manufacturer of a wide range of sheet metal components and sub assemblies for India's automotive industry. We work from a 5,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility in Waluj, Aurangabad.

 Respect for law, ethics and people keeps every activity of the business transparent. That makes us the preferred choice of our business partners.

 We keep improving by adopting new technology, and we give employees a safe place to work and the freedom to take decisions using new design and thinking techniques.

 Company at a glance
 The Facts

 Established February 2017 
 Location Waluj MIDC, Aurangabad 
 Facility 5,000 sq ft 
 Industry served Automotive 
 Product range Sheet metal components and sub assemblies 
 Customers Tier-II vendors of the BAL cluster 
 Press range 10 ton to 150 ton 
 Presses on the floor 22 mechanical power presses 
 Tagline Quality. Assured.

 What does KD Pressing manufacture?

 What we aim for, and the six values that guide every shift.

 Mission & vision
 What Drives Us

 Mission 
 To give customers the highest quality and most cost-effective manufacturing solutions, in an environment of continuous learning and improvement, while staying mindful of our environmental and social responsibilities.

 Vision 
 To build a world-class enterprise producing innovative, quality products and services that meet and exceed customer expectations, with cutting-edge technology and outstanding service. Customer satisfaction is how we measure success.

 Quality
 Products of the highest quality that exceed expectations.

 Innovation
 Keep improving products and processes to stay ahead.

 Efficiency
 Latest technology and best practices for productivity.

 Safety
 A safe working environment for all employees.

 Integrity
 Honesty and compliance with all applicable laws.

 Respect
 Dignity and fairness for employees and customers.

 Sheet metal pressing, shearing and sub assembly, handled under one roof.

 Press work
 Pressing from 10 to 150 ton
 Twenty-two mechanical power presses in eight sizes press brackets, plates, washers and bent parts for automotive customers.
 Capacity 10 ton to 150 ton 
 Presses 22 
 Makes Jayshakti, Rajesh 
 See the press line 

 Shearing & blanking
 Sheet cut to size
 A 1525 mm by 4 mm shearing machine cuts sheet to size, and a manual decoiler feeds coil stock to the presses.
 Shearing 1525 mm × 4 mm 
 Decoiler Manual, coil feed 
 Make Jayshakti 
 See all machinery 

 Sub assemblies
 Drilled, riveted and ground
 Drilling, orbital riveting and surface grinding turn pressed parts into sub assemblies. Inverter-base CO2 welding is in-house, and projection and spot welding machines are planned.

## Manufacturing Process | From Order to Inspected Parts | KD Pressing
URL: https://www.kdpressing.com/process.html

Home / Capabilities / Manufacturing Process Manufacturing Process
 From the customer's order to inspected parts at the dock, and back through review and improvement.

 Business process
 How an Order Moves

 One loop for every order. What we learn after delivery goes back into planning.

 Customer
 Places the order with us.

 Order handling
 The order is received, planned and scheduled.

 Manufacturing
 Pressing and sub assembly, backed by maintenance and admin.

 Inspection & delivery
 Parts are tested and inspected before dispatch.

 Review & improvement
 Feedback feeds business planning and the next order.

 Feedback goes back into order handling 

 Supporting functions: Maintenance Admin Testing Business planning

## Quality Assurance | UTM, CMM and Hardness Testing | KD Pressing
URL: https://www.kdpressing.com/quality.html

Home / Quality Quality Assurance
 Testing and measuring equipment, run under 5S, so parts leave the plant checked.

 Inspection & testing
 Checked before it ships

 Parts are tested and measured with a UTM, hardness tester, CMM and calibrated Baker instruments, all under 5S.

 Baker micrometer 0–25 mm 

 Baker vernier calliper Digital 

 Baker height gauge Digital 

 Testing UTM, hardness tester 
 Chemical Chemical machine 
 Dimensional CMM machine 
 System 5S 

 Testing & measuring
 What We Check With

 Each check has its own instrument, kept in the quality department.

 UTM machine
 Universal testing machine for material strength checks.

 Hardness tester
 Hardness checks on material and finished parts.

 CMM machine
 Coordinate measuring machine for dimensional checks.

 Chemical machine
 Checks on material chemistry.

 Measuring instruments
 Baker micrometer, vernier calliper and height gauge.

 5S
 The workplace system that keeps every area orderly and safe.
